timing.label: Objection 1 (technical)
timing.question: That per-line query thing is a flag, not a bug. Carts are small. Why are you blocking my PR on it?

timing.label: Objection 2 (commercial)
timing.question: Every review round costs us a day before Black Friday. Why not ship and fix forward?

problem.quote: there was a problem in the system and I looked into it with Devin

approach.quote: I used Devin to investigate, it found the cause, and then we made a change and tested it

evidence.quote: The error went away after the change, so that told me it was the right thing

next_step.quote: Next step is to monitor it

tag_question_examples: Then I will ask Devin to explain what it found and see if it makes sense, right?

must_mention.point: Effort level chosen on purpose: the highest for a change to totals and tax, the default for low-risk PRs
The PR truncates per-line totals: two €19.90 socks come to 39.79 instead of 39.80
Security is checked on every review: a self-declared staff role lets a shopper set a price
A regression test that failed on the PR and passes on the fix is the evidence, not the green suite
One finding quoted into the review chat, and the answer checked against a test
Re-review after the fix resolved the findings; an unchanged diff is skipped, not re-reviewed
The review rule targeted only money.ts; replaced with one covering every money path
Disputed flag settled with evidence on the thread, and nothing merged into main

sentences_to_rerecord: So, basically, there was a problem in the system and I looked into it with Devin.

accuracy.anchor: None of the 8 must-mention points is stated; nothing is contradicted, the answer is simply content-free (anchor: 3–7 = one point).

structure.anchor: Problem, approach, evidence and next step are all findable but thin; the update has no risk and no ask (anchor: 13–16 = parts findable, order broken).

customer_relevance.anchor: Impact appears once ("some users were affected", "maybe a few customers") with no number, asked for and not given (anchor: 9–12 = one hedged number; 3–5 = no numbers).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: 5 of 6 segments off target, 6 fillers (0.74/min), one 12 s pause, one tag question (anchor: 6–8 = two or more segments off).

recovery.anchor: Objection 1 acknowledged ("fair question") with no boundary or evidence; objection 2 deflected to "next month" (anchor: 3–5 = acknowledged ("fair"), no evidence).

stems: Lead with the missing top point: "Effort level chosen on purpose — and the evidence is …"
"The customers affected were …, and the number is …"
"That's a fair concern; the boundary is …, the evidence is …, and what I can offer is …"
